item.title: UK and EU complete deal to remove Brexit checks on food
item.body: The UK and EU have completed a deal to remove Brexit checks on imports and exports of food and animal products, from sausages and cheese to leather goods and flowers. It is expected to come into force in the first quarter of 2028.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 🇪🇺 UK and EU complete deal to remove Brexit checks on food

The UK and EU have completed a deal to remove Brexit checks on imports and exports of food and animal products, from sausages and cheese to leather goods and flowers. It is expected to come into force in the first quarter of 2028.

Source: Guardian | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 3 November, 09:50
